chapter: Reflections on Paris guitarists and saxophonists
title: Racial strain on Black musicians and relief in Europe
summary: Asked about Lester Young, Butler says Black musicians are under constant mental strain from racial headlines, which lifts abroad; some use the freedom to learn and others do not.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Now, did you hear Lester Young when you got back to America?

Yes, indeed, I heard Lester Young. Yes, sir.Unfortunately, Lester didn't go to France -- or didn't stay a long time. It would have prolonged his life. I'll tell you why. You see, you can say what you want to, but a musician, he's under strain all the time.
Under strain all the time/ because you see, what happens is, he's under the strain, I mean, mentally -- I mean, if he's a musician of color.
He's sensitive in ear and he's sensitive of many things and he's hearing all of these racial things and he knows that that's what's happening. Everyday.
Every caption -- sex-crazed negro, sex-drugged crazed negro attacks detective, Samuel Green, age seven, alleged to have stolen a couple of bananas. That's the caption, and you see that.
Now, all these things -- but you don't have that. In your mind -- why do I feel so good? Because you don't have that. You are not on guard all the time, so you feel relaxed. Do you understand?
Real relaxing. That is what happens.
So, they go up there and it's like on vacation with no radio, so you don't hear this. You'd hear this or that, what's going on so that's why -- he may not take advantage of it.
Probably he would say, oh, they got me going here and doing that and I'm having my fun. You can have fun but if he's conscious of himself -- it depends upon the man.
So, some guys -- he goes over there and says, I'm
to do my stuff. Do everything ugly. I made myself a better man. I got a chance to see something. See Notre Dame and when was it built and why.
See, some guys go over there and he don't know, don't go further than where he live at. Oh, yes, man, I know all about -- he don't know nothing. So, that's how things are.
